weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，今天是深入研究你一直好奇的事情的絕佳機會。擁抱冒險可以激發你的創造力並提高你的能量水平，這兩者對你的精神至關重要。你的藝術才華依賴新鮮的體驗，所以尋找新的刺激來滋養你的思想。無論是探索不同的社區還是嘗試新的活動，今天就走出舒適區，獲得急需的腎上腺素激增。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, today is the perfect opportunity to dive into something you've been curious about. Embracing adventure can ignite your creativity and boost your energy levels, both of which are vital for your spirit. Your artistic side thrives on fresh experiences, so seek out new stimuli to nourish your mind. Whether it's exploring a different neighborhood or trying a new activity, step outside your comfort zone today to get that much-needed adrenaline rush.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，今天的氣氛鼓勵你開始整理你的空間。深入研究那些辦公桌抽屜、壁櫥、儲物區或文件櫃。透過讓周圍的環境變得秩序井然，你會培養出一種寧靜和賦權的感覺。此外，進行心理組織——例如設定目標、集思廣益或規劃日程——會增強這種感覺。旨在盡可能地清除精神和身體上的混亂。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today’s vibes encourage you, Taurus, to start organizing your space. Dive into those desk drawers, closets, storage areas, or filing cabinets. By bringing order to your surroundings, you’ll cultivate a sense of tranquility and empowerment. Additionally, engaging in mental organization—like setting goals, brainstorming ideas, or planning your schedule—will enhance this feeling. Aim to clear out both your mental and physical clutter as much as you can.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天的氛圍充滿力量，讓你感覺有能力應付任何挑戰。然而，鑑於你的大膽心態，保持一些克制是明智的。你天生的人道主義意識很強，所以要小心——如果你的野心是以犧牲他人為代價的，可能會在你內部產生衝突。在採取行動之前花點時間反思您的選擇，確保您與道德指南針保持一致。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, the vibes today are empowering, making you feel capable of tackling any challenge. However, with your bold mindset, it's wise to exercise some restraint. Your innate sense of humanitarianism is strong, so be cautious—if your ambitions come at the expense of others, it could create a conflict within you. Take a moment to reflect on your choices before acting, ensuring you stay aligned with your moral compass.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今天可能為你提供一個絕佳的機會，讓你重新審視過去未按計劃進行的努力。雖然面對挫折可能會動搖您的信心和自我價值，但請記住，這些經驗對於個人成長和適應能力至關重要。敢於再次嘗試，不僅可以培養勇氣，還可以增強決心。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today could present an excellent opportunity for you to revisit a past endeavor that didn’t go as planned, Cancer. While facing setbacks can shake your confidence and self-worth, remember that these experiences are essential to personal growth and resilience. By daring to try again, you not only cultivate bravery but also strengthen your determination.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你創造性解決問題的能力可能會大放異彩。精力充沛，思維清晰，你會發現任務進展順利。當你處理你的專案時，花點時間探索所有潛在的途徑。透過從不同的角度看待情況，您可能會發現大量以前沒有考慮過的選擇。別忘了寫下你的想法！
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, your knack for creative problem-solving is likely to shine. With a surge of energy and sharp mental clarity, you'll notice that tasks flow smoothly. As you tackle your projects, take a moment to explore all potential avenues. By viewing situations from different perspectives, you may uncover a wealth of options that you hadn't considered before. Don't forget to jot down your thoughts!

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，如果你一直盯著堆積如山的未完成任務，今天是你正面解決它們的機會。對於昨天漏掉的物品來說尤其如此。幸運的是，你擁有更強的力量和敏銳的思維清晰度。當您深入處理待辦事項清單時，請期待順利的旅程。利用這種充滿活力的能量並避免任何延誤；拖延只會讓工作量變得更重。現在就採取行動，您將體驗到美妙的成就感。
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, if you've been staring at a mountain of unfinished tasks, today is your chance to tackle them head-on. This is particularly true for the items that slipped through the cracks yesterday. Luckily, you're equipped with enhanced strength and sharp mental clarity. Expect a smooth ride as you dive into your to-do list. Harness this vibrant energy and avoid any delays; putting things off will only make the workload heavier. Take action now, and you'll experience a wonderful sense of accomplishment.

libra.horoscope_en: Libra, there's no need to stress about productivity today. You may find yourself achieving more than you have in quite a while. The celestial vibes suggest that if you fell short of your goals yesterday, today is your chance to catch up. Stand firm and take action; you'll complete your tasks with time to spare. If you have a creative passion, dive into that as well—it will bring you great satisfaction.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you may find yourself brimming with extra physical vitality. It's a perfect opportunity to tackle those cluttered closets. Engaging in activities like yoga or a brisk walk will bring you joy. Additionally, take some time to reflect on your aspirations. Are you on the right path in your life, or is it time for some adjustments? Challenge both your mind and body for a fulfilling day.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, if you've been struggling to wrap up some projects or tasks, today brings a burst of energy that will help you tackle them with enthusiasm. Once you take that first step, you'll find that everything falls into place. It's an excellent day for networking and discussing business matters or other plans with others. Your enhanced communication and teamwork abilities will streamline decision-making, making it smoother than ever.

capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, today you may find yourself brimming with energy like never before. This surge of vitality enhances both your mental sharpness and physical prowess, making it the perfect time to tackle any outstanding tasks. If you've already made significant progress and have some extra time on your hands, consider lending a hand to others who may need it. Just remember to prioritize your own responsibilities first!

Your physical and mental vitality are on the rise, empowering you to shed any doubts or hesitations. Embrace your natural talent for making wise decisions and let that guide you as you move forward with your project or goal. Now is the time to take action and claim what you desire.

You'll experience a revitalizing boost that enhances both your creativity and physical vitality. Take advantage of this by engaging in outdoor activities, whether it's playing a sport or simply going for a stroll. These activities will help channel your energy and provide clarity for your thoughts. You might find that your concentration improves as the day progresses. Embrace this opportunity!
